answer: Give every identity a small orchard of trust that only grows when independent peers vouch for its real work, one verified task at a time. Each vouch costs the voucher a slice of their own standing, so endorsements stay scarce and honest. An attacker trying to raise a thousand fake orchards faces a spiral: every new identity needs its own slow season of genuine vouches, and buying them costs more standing than the fakes can ever earn back, like trying to fill an ocean with a cup while the reward for each fake stays flat.
